acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode using a data dependent acquisition method.
cleavage_agent: Tryptic digestion was performed for 3 h with 0.1 μg trypsin (Promega Sequencing Grade; Madison, WI) per sample.
fractionation_method: Peptides were loaded directly onto the analytical column and were separated by reversed-phase chromatography using a 50-cm column with an inner diameter of 75 μm, packed with 2 μm C18 particles spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA, USA) with a 90 min chromatographic gradient.
fragmentation_method: collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD)
